"""Check the production scoring command on the archived FineWeb pilot."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from rich.console import Console


def sha(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def run_scoring(base, manifest, out, columns, seeds, *, bpb_only, expected):
    command = [
        sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.eval_matrix", "matrix",
        "--device-type", "cuda", "--data", "fineweb", "--checkpoint-dir",
        str(base / "base_checkpoints" / manifest["checkpoint_template"]),
        "--matrix-manifest", str(manifest["path"]), "--checkpoint-step", "16",
        "--presets", ",".join(columns), "--seeds", ",".join(map(str, seeds)),
        "--eval-bpb", "--eval-tokens", "1048576", "--device-batch-size", "8",
        "--out-dir", str(out), "--fail-fast",
    ]
    if bpb_only:
        command.append("--bpb-only")
    started = time.monotonic()
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)
    seconds = time.monotonic() - started
    table, = out.rglob("summary.jsonl")
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in table.read_text().splitlines()]
    by_cell = {(r["preset"], r["seed"]): r for r in rows}
    assert list(by_cell) == [(arm, seed) for arm in columns for seed in seeds]
    assert len(rows) == len(by_cell)
    for key, row in by_cell.items():
        old = expected[key]
        assert row["status"] == "ok"
        assert row["model_file_sha256"] == old["checkpoint_hash"]
        assert row["val_bpb"] == old["val_bpb"]
        assert row["eval_tokens_processed"] == old["heldout_positions"] == 1048576
        assert row["matrix_manifest_digest"] == manifest["run_id"]
        assert row["eval_data_digest"] == manifest["data"]["val_sha256"]
        assert row["tokenizer_digest"] == manifest["data"]["tokenizer_sha256"]
        if bpb_only:
            assert set(row["capability_metric_status"].values()) == {"not_run"}
            for name in ("val_loss", "val_ppl", "id_ece", "ood_auroc", "niah_acc", "forgetting_rate", "core_metric"):
                assert row[name] is None, name
        else:
            assert row["capability_metric_status"]["uncertainty"] == "ok"
            assert row["val_loss"] is not None and row["id_ece"] is not None
    return {
        "argv": command,
        "wall_seconds": seconds,
        "cells": rows,
        "summary_jsonl_sha256": sha(table),
        "summary_csv_sha256": sha(table.with_suffix(".csv")),
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("base", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("manifest", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("out_dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    manifest = json.loads(args.manifest.read_text())
    manifest["path"] = args.manifest
    assert not manifest["registered"] and manifest["protocol_id"] == "exploratory"
    reference = json.loads(Path("results/fineweb_accelerated_2026-11-24.json").read_text())
    recount = reference["checkpoint_recount"]
    assert recount["manifest"]["run_id"] == manifest["run_id"]
    expected = {(cell["arm"], cell["seed"]): cell["bpb_replay"] for cell in recount["cells"]}
    console = Console()
    columns, seeds = ["synaptic_off"], [1337]
    warmup = run_scoring(args.base, manifest, args.out_dir / "warmup", columns, seeds,
                         bpb_only=True, expected=expected)
    console.print(f"Untimed warmup completed in {warmup['wall_seconds']:.3f} wall seconds")
    rounds = []
    for index in range(4):
        order = (True, False) if index % 2 == 0 else (False, True)
        samples = {}
        order_labels = []
        for focused in order:
            label = "bpb_only" if focused else "full"
            result = run_scoring(args.base, manifest, args.out_dir / f"round-{index}" / label, columns, seeds,
                                 bpb_only=focused, expected=expected)
            samples[label] = result
            order_labels.append(label)
            console.print(f"Round {index + 1} {label} completed in {result['wall_seconds']:.3f} wall seconds")
        rounds.append({"order": order_labels, "samples": samples})
    outcome = {"warmup": warmup, "rounds": rounds}
    with (args.out_dir / "balanced.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as output:
        json.dump(outcome, output, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        output.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        if bpb_only:
            assert set(row["capability_metric_status"].values()) == {"not_run"}
            for name in ("val_loss", "val_ppl", "id_ece", "ood_auroc", "niah_acc", "forgetting_rate", "core_metric"):
                assert row[name] is None, name

        "summary_csv_sha256": sha(table.with_suffix(".csv")),
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("six", "paired"))
    parser.add_argument("base", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("manifest", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("out_dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

        outcome[label] = result
        Console().print(f"{label} completed {len(result['cells'])} cells in {result['wall_seconds']:.3f} seconds")
    with (args.out_dir / f"{mode}.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as output:
        json.dump(outcome, output, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        output.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
